name: Dinner For Two
source:
When Nicki bumps into Amie, it feels like a divine gift bestowed upon her. She's just so lovely, just so beautiful.  Nicki can't help but to feel such intense adoration for the [s]stranger[/s] woman! How could Nicki ever let this opportunity go? Help Nicki secure her dearest Amie or die trying.

[Edited from [url=https://yappingbimbo.itch.io/dinner-for-two]itch.io[/url]]
